questions.text: The Constitution of India was adopted on:
questions.solution: The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into effect on 26 January 1950

questions.solution: Asia is the largest continent, covering about 30% of Earth's land area

questions.solution: Dadabhai Naoroji propounded the "Drain Theory" in his book "Poverty and Un-British Rule in India"

questions.text: Which of the following is a renewable resource?
questions.solution: Solar energy is renewable; fossil fuels are non-renewable

questions.text: The ozone layer is found in which layer of the atmosphere?
questions.solution: The ozone layer is located in the stratosphere, approximately 15-35 km above Earth's surface

questions.solution: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constitution

questions.solution: The collision between the Indian Plate and the Eurasian Plate formed the Himalayas

questions.solution: The Green Revolution focused on high-yielding varieties of wheat and rice

questions.solution: Carbon dioxide is the primary greenhouse gas emitted through human activities

questions.text: A train 200 m long crosses a platform 300 m long in 30 seconds. Find its speed in m/s.
questions.solution: Total distance = 200+300 = 500 m. Speed = 500/30 = 50/3 m/s

A person buys 10 oranges for ₹30 and sells them at 6 for ₹24. What is the profit/loss percentage?
questions.solution: CP per orange = ₹3. SP per orange = ₹4. Profit = ₹1 per orange. Profit% = 1/3 × 100 = 33.33%

questions.text: Find the compound interest on ₹5000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
A boat travels 20 km upstream in 5 hours and 24 km downstream in 3 hours. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.solution: Upstream speed = 20/5 = 4 km/h. Downstream speed = 24/3 = 8 km/h. Stream speed = (8-4)/2 = 2 km/h

questions.text: In how many years will ₹2000 become ₹2420 at 10% per annum compounded annually?
A bag contains 3 red, 4 blue, and 5 green balls. One ball is picked at random. What is the probability it is blue?
questions.solution: Total = 12 balls. Blue = 4. P = 4/12 = 1/3

questions.text: A and B invest ₹5000 and ₹8000 in a business. If the total profit is ₹2600 after one year, what is A's share?
How many 3-digit numbers are divisible by 7?
questions.solution: First 3-digit multiple of 7 = 105 (15×7). Last = 994 (142×7). Count = 142-15+1 = 128

questions.text: The diameter of a cylinder is 14 cm and height is 20 cm. Find its volume.
questions.solution: Radius = 7 cm. Volume = πr²h = 22/7 × 49 × 20 = 22 × 7 × 20 = 3080 cm³

questions.text: In how many ways can the letters of the word "LEADER" be arranged?
questions.solution: 6 letters with E repeated twice. Arrangements = 6!/2! = 720/2 = 360

questions.text: A milkman mixes water with milk in ratio 1:4. If he sells the mixture at ₹40/L making 25% profit, find the cost price of pure milk.
questions.solution: SP = 40 at 25% profit → CP = 40/1.25 = 32 per L of mixture. In 5L mixture: 1L water + 4L milk. Cost of 4L milk = 5×32 = 160. CP of milk = 160/4 = 40/L
